annotations.title: Find the fix for an accessibility problem

description: Searches the Learn guides by words, component name, tag, ARIA attribute or WCAG number (1.4.3, SC 2.1.1, JIS 達成基準, EN 301 549 9.x). Returns for each matching topic: the problem, the fix in one line, how to test it, the guide link, and the criterion in WCAG terms, with EN 301 549 and Section 508 in English or JIS X 8341-3 in Japanese. Topics with no guide yet come back as "in progress". For a finding, a complaint, a failing check or a question that names a problem.

limit.description: Topics to return at most (default 8, max 20)

locale.description: Language of the answer and the guides: en (default) or ja. English answers cite EN 301 549 and Section 508; Japanese answers cite JIS X 8341-3:2016.

query.description: Words, a tag, an ARIA attribute or a WCAG number

name: find_fix
